source.title: libraryts baseline run (no public per-dataset values)
source.locator: Measured 2026-10-15 via `libraryts train/run --algorithm PyODKNNDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo` (model probe-knn-yahoo); TSB-UAD README 'Overall Results' table has no KNN column

entries.notes: TSB-UAD (PVLDB 2022) does not evaluate KNN, and TSB-AD (NeurIPS 2024) only publishes Sub-KNN averages on its own re-curated datasets, so no public per-dataset AUC-ROC exists for these series; the groundtruth is a libraryts baseline measured with this exact pipeline on 2026-10-15. Tolerance 0.05 is a re-run sanity band (KNN is deterministic), not a paper comparison. MITDB is excluded for KNN: ~97 s per 650k-point series x 32 series ~ 52 min, over the 30-min per-command budget (the precedent that dropped OCSVM on MITDB/MGAB).

source.title: libraryts baseline run (no public per-dataset values)
source.locator: Measured 2026-10-15 via `libraryts train/run --algorithm PyODCBLOFDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo` (model probe-cblof10-yahoo); TSB-UAD README 'Overall Results' table has no CBLOF column

entries.notes: TSB-UAD (PVLDB 2022) does not evaluate CBLOF and TSB-AD (NeurIPS 2024) publishes no results for it, so no public per-dataset AUC-ROC exists for these series; the groundtruth is a libraryts baseline measured with this exact pipeline on 2026-10-15. n_clusters=10 instead of the catalog default 8: with 8, pyod CBLOF fails its cluster-separation check on 14/367 YAHOO series. NAB and Genesis are excluded: they contain constant/binary series (NAB_data_art0_1/art0_3, genesis-anomalies.test.csv@17) on which CBLOF cannot form valid clusters at any n_clusters, and libraryts aborts multi-series training on the first failing series. Dodgers is excluded as well: its single series makes the unseeded k-means baseline swing 0.36-0.41 across repeats. k-means is unseeded; three repeat runs of this pipeline spread <=0.012 on the four retained datasets, so tolerance 0.10 is comfortable.
entries.train_command: libraryts train --algorithm PyODCBLOFDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo --model-id bench-detection-cblof-yahoo-auc --param n_clusters=10 --param contamination=0.1

entries.settings: Unsupervised fit per series; detector applied point-wise to raw 1-D values; point-wise AUC-ROC averaged over all 32 MITDB series
